name: Malformed Content-Length
description: Three framing faults that must be rejected before any rule is consulted. No rules are needed.

scenarios.name: non-numeric-content-length
scenarios.description: Content-Length: abc cannot be parsed, so the body length is unknowable and the stream cannot be resynchronised. The peer answers 400 and closes.

scenarios.name: negative-content-length
scenarios.description: Content-Length: -1 is syntactically a number but cannot describe a body. Rejected with its own distinct reason code.

scenarios.name: duplicate-content-length
scenarios.description: Two Content-Length headers disagree about where the body ends. Accepting either one would risk desynchronising the stream, so the message is rejected.
